_what: Bing Webmaster Tools baseline, read from the signed-in console on 2026-08-26. Bing matters disproportionately for this programme because its index feeds ChatGPT Search and Copilot.

ai_performance._what: Total Citations, 3-month window, source 'Microsoft Copilots and Partners'. This is a DIFFERENT retrieval surface from the OpenRouter :online grounded probe in data/signals/llm_citation_observations.json, and it disagrees with it.
ai_performance._note: Grounding-query detail returns 'No data available' at this volume, so which queries produced these citations is not yet knowable from this report.

theindustryguides.com._note: About half the 2,393-page library is not in Bing's index. 17 impressions across 1,200 indexed pages over six months is effectively no demand reaching them.

backlinks._note: Zero backlinks in Bing's index. Expected: the authority-backlink-network links to this property carry rel='sponsored nofollow', which is correct disclosure and by design does not pass or register as endorsement.

orphan_correlation._what: Orphan count measured by direct link-graph analysis of rendered HTML on 2026-08-26, set against Bing AI citations over the same window.
orphan_correlation._why_it_matters: The ordering is the finding. The property with the fewest orphans is the most cited, and every property at zero citations is also near-total orphaned. Sitemaps and IndexNow do not substitute for internal links: theindustryguides.com received 100,300 IndexNow submissions and still indexes about half its library.

rows.note: orphans fixed 2026-08-26 from 3016; citations predate the fix

orphan_correlation._caveat: Correlation on nine properties is not proof of cause, and page count, age, topic competitiveness and index coverage all vary between them. It is consistent with the direct measurement that on one property the indexed set was almost exactly the linked set.
